messages:
ashley: Hey team — a customer reported that our JSON-mode outputs started breaking after yesterday's model swap. Their client parses the response and now fails with a SyntaxError.

ashley: They say we used to return an object with top-level "results", now it's returning an array (no key) and sometimes a trailing comma. Repro attached below.

sam: thanks ashley. do we have the exact request payload and the raw response?

ashley: yep. curl they used: 
```
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-llama-3-2.1","mode":"json","prompt":"explain: {\"topic\": \"caching\"}","json_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"results":{"type":"array"}}}}'
```

ashley: raw response they got (client failed parsing):
```
[
  {
    "id": "r-abc123",
    "items": [
      { "text": "Caching reduces repeated compute..." }
    ],
  },
]
```

ashley: note the trailing commas and array top-level. previously we returned {"results": [...] }. customer says this started after we switched their workspace to the new 2.1 runtime last night.

lee: ugh. that looks like a serialization bug in the new model handler. on the infra side we did change the model container image tag from redwood-runtime:2.0 -> :2.1 which includes a new fast-serializer.

maya-oncall: adding oncall. can you paste the request id or workspace id so we can trace logs?

ashley: workspace: ws_6642, example request id from the customer's header: r-abc123, timestamp 2026-03-16T22:11:05Z.

sam: i'm pulling the logs. quick mitigation: ashley, can you ask the customer to pin model to redwood-llama-3-2.0 for now? we can also enable a temporary response-validator to strip trailing commas.

lee: found the handler trace: the new serializer toggles \"compact_arrays\": true which incorrectly emits top-level arrays for single-field responses when schema enforcement is off. there is also an edge case where trailing commas are emitted when a metadata field is null.

lee: repro on my box:
```python
# small repro of bad serialization from the runtime image
resp = serializer.serialize({})  # expects {"results": []} but emits []
print(resp)  # shows top-level array and trailing comma
```

maya-oncall: escalated to eng-runtime. priority P1 due to customer parsing errors in prod. tagging eng-ml because model handshake changed behavior.

lee: immediate action plan:
- revert serializer toggle in runtime image to legacy behavior (hotfix build)
- add a strict JSON-mode validator in the gateway that enforces top-level matches to json_schema
- create a short-term proxy that rewrites top-level arrays back into {"results": array} for affected workspaces

ashley: i've informed customer about pinning to 2.0. they're okay with a short rollback but asked for ETA.

sam: ETA for emergency rollback build? i can cut a hotfix branch and deploy a hotfix image within ~90 minutes if QA is green.

lee: i'll prepare the patch and a unit test that asserts top-level object name preserved when json_schema provided. also will add serialization regression test for trailing commas.

maya-oncall: please post updates here. once hotfix deployed, i'll run through the customer's failing request and confirm parsing success.

ashley: customer asked whether this could have billing impact (their client retried on parse failure causing duplicate requests). flagged to finance.

sam: noted. support-bot, please create an incident ticket and include workspace ws_6642 and the request ids.

support-bot: Created INC-2026-0448 for workspace ws_6642 — assigned to eng-runtime, priority P1.

lee: hotfix built and pushed to staging image tag redwood-runtime:2.1.1-hotfix. starting rolling deploy to canary.

ashley: customer confirmed they pinned to 2.0 and retried — parsing succeeds now. they will hold off on going back until we confirm fix.

maya-oncall: canary looks good. no other workspaces hit this yet according to logs. pushing hotfix to prod in 20m.

sam: prod hotfix pushed. monitoring traces for serialization errors.

lee: after hotfix there's a 0 occurrences of the trailing-comma serialization in the last 30m window. pushing a follow-up patch to add a serializer unit test to CI.

ashley: customer verified on prod. they also provided vendor client logs showing duplicate billing events — support will coordinate with finance to reconcile.

maya-oncall: closing loop: next steps — (1) postmortem note with root cause: serializer toggle + missing schema enforcement; (2) add validator in gateway; (3) add CI test; (4) billing reconciliation. assign owners.

ashley: thanks all. will keep thread updated if customer sees anything else. :thumbsup:
